name: Netflix
why: Largest U.S. paid video streaming service (catalog approx 89M U.S. members); national brand.

name: Hulu
why: Major national streaming service (Disney); distinct hulu.com account and billing site.

name: HBO Max
why: Major national streaming service (Warner Bros. Discovery), far larger than Sling TV; WarnerMedia-billed Subscription page with plan, payment and cancel. Replaces Sling TV (much smaller live-TV service; its dossier stays valid as an extra dedicated biller).

name: Disney+
why: Major national streaming service with its own Disney account billing.

name: Amazon Prime (incl. Prime Video)
why: Top of status.mjs popularity list; most widely held paid membership in the U.S. (duplicate record amazon-prime-membership-05c923 not picked).

name: Spotify Premium
why: Largest music streaming subscription in the U.S.; distinct billing flow (Manage your plan).

name: YouTube TV
why: Largest U.S. live-TV streaming service; billed through Google with its own membership settings.

name: Paramount+
why: Major national streaming service; on the status.mjs popularity list.

name: Peacock
why: Major national streaming service (NBCUniversal); on the status.mjs popularity list.

name: SiriusXM
why: Largest U.S. satellite radio/streaming audio subscription; distinctive phone/chat-only cancellation.

name: Apple subscriptions (Apple One, Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+)
why: Apple bills a very large share of U.S. households for its own services and for in-app subscriptions; one Subscriptions page and Apple One bundles. Duplicate record apple-one-icloud-apple-subscriptions-3c2ba3 not picked.

name: Microsoft 365
why: Most widely held consumer software subscription in the U.S.; Services & subscriptions page with recurring billing on/off.

name: Costco membership
why: Largest U.S. paid retail membership (annual fee); online Auto Renewal, offline cancellation.

name: AARP membership
why: About 38M members (catalog approx_customers); renew without signing in, Automatic Renewal turned off by phone.

name: The New York Times
why: Largest U.S. news subscription (about 11M+); four-week billing, Home Delivery Autopay and mail payments. Duplicate record the-new-york-times-print-home-delivery-digital-5da255 not picked.

name: STARZ
why: National premium streaming service (independent of tier-1 companies); billed directly or through partners.

name: Philo
why: Independent national live-TV streaming service on the status.mjs list; plan change and cancel online.

name: Uber One
why: One of the largest U.S. paid delivery/rides memberships; app-managed auto-renewing membership.

name: DoorDash DashPass
why: Largest U.S. food-delivery membership; Manage DashPass cancel/pause.

name: Instacart+
why: Major national grocery-delivery membership; online auto-renew, plan and cancel management.
